summary: Completed comprehensive Phase 1.5 hardening pass testing. All backend APIs and frontend UI components tested successfully. New features verified: basin grouping, threshold validation doctrine, refresh attempt tracking, Phase 2 placeholder sections, and enhanced detail dialog with 'Why this status?' panel.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/system/status returns phase=1, phase_label='Phase 1 • Real-Data MVP (1.5 hardening)', stations_active=6, last_attempt with all fields
Backend: GET /api/system/basins returns 6 basin groups (cedar-lk-washington, snoqualmie-snohomish, skagit, nooksack, green-duwamish, puyallup-white)
Backend: GET /api/stations returns 6 stations with basin_group, active, notes, precursors fields
Backend: All stations have thresholds.validated boolean field
Backend: All stations have precursors object with available=False (Phase 2 placeholder)
Backend: POST /api/refresh updates last_attempt.attempted_at timestamp correctly
Backend Doctrine: green-auburn and white-auburn have thresholds.source='thresholds_unavailable', validated=False, risk_state='unknown'
Backend Doctrine: cedar-renton, snoqualmie-carnation, skagit-mt-vernon, nooksack-ferndale have thresholds.source='official_nwps', validated=True
Backend Doctrine: When thresholds.validated=False, risk_state='unknown' is enforced (verified for green-auburn, white-auburn)
Backend Doctrine: When thresholds.source='official_nwps', validated=True is enforced (verified for all 4 NWPS stations)
Backend: GET /api/stations/{id} works for all 6 station IDs
Backend: GET /api/stations/invalid-id correctly returns 404
Backend: POST /api/stations/{id}/refresh advances fetched_at timestamp
Frontend: Dashboard loads with NavBar, HeroStatusPanel (data-testid=hero-status-panel), and last-attempt indicator (data-testid=hero-status-last-attempt) showing 'refresh OK'
Frontend: HeroStatusPanel displays phaseLabel reference ('Phase 1' visible)
Frontend: FilterBar (data-testid=filter-bar) renders with all 7 basin chips (filter-basin-all + 6 basin groups)
Frontend: FilterBar renders with all 6 risk chips (filter-risk-all, calm, watch, elevated, flood, unknown)
Frontend: Clicking filter-basin-skagit narrows grid to 1 station, chip becomes active (data-active=true), section header shows '1 of 6', Clear button appears
Frontend: Clicking filter-clear clears filters and returns all 6 stations
Frontend: Combined filtering works (basin + risk): Skagit + calm shows 1 station, Skagit + flood shows empty state (data-testid=dashboard-filter-empty)
Frontend: All 6 station cards have data-basin-group attribute matching backend basin_group field
Frontend: Source badges have correct data-source values: 4 cards with data-source='official_nwps', 2 cards with data-source='thresholds_unavailable' (green-auburn, white-auburn)

Frontend: Clicking station card opens StationDetailDialog (data-testid=station-detail-dialog) with all 6 sections: station-why-status, station-section-observed, station-section-thresholds, station-section-provenance, station-section-notes, station-section-precursors
Frontend: Cedar River detail dialog shows thresholds section with 'Official' source label and NO validation warning in why-status panel (correct for validated=True)
Frontend: Green River detail dialog shows thresholds section with 'unavailable' label and SHOWS validation warning in why-status panel (correct for validated=False)
Frontend: Mobile responsiveness at 390x844 viewport - filter chips scroll horizontally, station cards collapse to single column, detail dialog opens and is scrollable
Frontend: Manual NavBar refresh button (data-testid=nav-refresh-button) triggers refresh and updates hero-status-last-attempt indicator timestamp
Frontend: /roadmap route renders with all 5 phase cards, Phase 1 marked 'CURRENTLY ACTIVE'
